verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a root llms.txt at canva.dev (HTTP 200) indexing Canva's developer documentation. Section-level llms.txt files exist for SCIM, Admin and audit logs, and docs pages are served as agent-friendly .md (connect.md, apps.md, apps/mcp.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs; the probed /docs/.md path returned 404, which leaves the scope of markdown coverage less certain.
